current.headline: Hold your oversold positions patiently, trim the one winner flashing overbought, and stop the bleeding on TEM before it gets worse.
current.overall_thesis: With 5.87% in the red, a VIX in neutral territory, and Fear & Greed sitting at 38, this is not the time to chase new positions or add risk. The priority is capital preservation and intelligent recovery — trim XLK while it still has juice, let ABT and MSFT mean-revert on their own timelines, and enforce the $44 stop on TEM without emotion. Over the next 4-8 weeks, the goal is to flatten the overall P&L, reduce INTU concentration below 25%, and exit TEM cleanly if the stop is hit.
top_priorities: TRIM XLK immediately — RSI at 79.5 is a clear overbought signal and locking in partial gains from your only strong winner is non-negotiable given the current defensive posture
ENFORCE the $44 stop on TEM — you are down 28% with zero confirmed entry signals; do not let a swing trade become a long-term hold out of hope
MONITOR INTU concentration — at 33% it breaches your 25% cap; do not add to it and be ready to trim into any technical strength post-earnings to rebalance
current.biggest_risk: TEM breaches $44 and you hesitate — a 28% loss that turns into 40%+ is the single fastest way to derail recovery across the entire portfolio.
what_to_watch: TEM price vs. $44 stop level — check daily, no exceptions, no rationalizing a hold below that line
XLK RSI normalization — watch for RSI to pull back toward 60-65 as a signal that the trim was well-timed and the position is stabilizing
ABT RSI and Bollinger Band position — RSI at 23.1 is deeply oversold; a bounce toward RSI 35-40 with price moving off the lower band is your confirmation that the mean-reversion thesis is activating
on_course_check: Plan is working if: XLK trim is executed within 2 weeks, TEM is closed at or above $44 if stop is triggered, and total portfolio drawdown stops widening beyond -6%

Plan needs revision if: ABT continues falling with no RSI recovery after 3 weeks, MSFT golden cross fails to materialize and price breaks below its current base, or overall P&L drawdown accelerates past -8%
